title: Credit Administration Policy on Applying Member Equities & Patronage against a Defaulted Loan
content:
When a loan of the member has been past due the class's offset trigger in calendar days or more and the credit officer has charged it off or begun collection, the association may apply the member's Member Equities & Patronage equity of a class open to offset against that loan.

## Policy

1. **Loans in default.** A loan qualifies when an installment, interest bill or matured balance on it is unpaid the class's offset trigger in calendar days or more past its due date, and the credit officer has charged the loan off or begun collection.
2. **Order of application.** Borrower equity first, then Qualified and then Nonqualified Allocated Surplus, oldest allocation year first, up to the amount owed on the loan.
3. **Recording.** Each offset is a retirement entry recorded as an offset against a defaulted loan, naming the loan and its line, which books a principal payment on that loan.
4. **Never offset.** Preferred stock is never offset.
5. **Never on request, never for a late loan.** An offset is never made at a member's request and never against a loan that is merely late.

## Hypothetical application (offset trigger 180 calendar days)

An equipment loan with USD 2,600.00 owed has an installment unpaid 195 calendar days past its due date and has been placed in collection by the credit officer. The member holds Class B Voting Stock of USD 1,000.00, Qualified Allocated Surplus of USD 900.00 for 2021 and USD 500.00 for 2023, and Nonqualified Allocated Surplus of USD 700.00 for 2021. Up to the USD 2,600.00 owed, the association may apply USD 1,000.00 of Class B Voting Stock, then USD 900.00 of 2021 and USD 500.00 of 2023 Qualified Allocated Surplus, then USD 200.00 of 2021 Nonqualified Allocated Surplus — each as its own offset entry naming the equipment loan, each booking a principal payment on it. Any Class H Preferred Stock the member holds is not touched.

An installment unpaid 40 calendar days past due makes the loan late, not in default for this policy, and nothing is applied.
